content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chesapeake

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management work experience. Review PMI's prerequisites—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented project hours, or equivalent alternative qualifications. Verify your background meets the standard before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions online at times that fit your schedule. Receive direct instruction in project-management frameworks, real-world case studies, and exam-focused content over the full program duration.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the required PMI exam fee. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guides to reinforce course material. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Test at an approved center or via remote proctoring on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue continuing education, volunteer work, or advanced certifications. Renew your credential by the deadline to sustain recognition in your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
